model_annotations.English: The line plot illustrates "Veterans as share of population" over time. The x-axis, which lacks an explicit label but denotes years, operates on a linear scale ranging from 1960 to 2010 with tick labels positioned at 10-year intervals. The y-axis is also unlabeled but represents percentages, utilizing a linear scale that ranges from 0 to 15% with tick marks displayed at intervals of 5. The chart features a single solid red line with hollow circular markers denoting specific data points, each accompanied by an exact numerical label. The line begins at a value of 12.8 in 1960, rises to a peak of 13.8 in 1970, and then experiences a steady, continuous decline across the remainder of the x-axis, recording values of 12.1 in 1980, 11.0 in 1990, and 9.4 in 2000, before ending at a final value of 7% in 2010.
model_annotations.German: The line plot, titled "Veterans as share of population," illustrates the percentage of the population identified as veterans over a period of time. The x-axis lacks an explicit label but represents years on a linear scale ranging from 1960 to 2010, with numeric tick labels plotted at regular 10-year intervals. The y-axis also lacks an explicit label but represents percentages on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 15, with the top tick marked as "15%" to denote the unit, and numeric tick labels spaced at regular intervals of 5. The data is represented by a single solid red line with hollow circular markers at each data point. The line begins at a value of 12.8 in 1960, rises to a peak of 13.8 in 1970, and then experiences a steady, continuous decline across the remainder of the x-axis. Specifically, the data values drop to 12.1 in 1980, 11.0 in 1990, and 9.4 in 2000, before concluding at its lowest point of 7% at the end of the x-axis in 2010.
